privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.updated: Plain-language notice under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
privacy.whoBody: Company A is the authorised Brand X dealer in Lucknow. We decide how your personal data is used on this website.
whatItems: Your name and mobile number (needed to call you back)
Your email address, only if you give it
The car, showroom and time you chose, and any message you write
The date and time you gave consent
whyItems: To call or message you about your enquiry or test drive
To confirm, change or remind you of a booking
To pass your request to the right consultant at the showroom
privacy.notBody: We don't sell your data. We don't send marketing to anyone who hasn't consented, and we stop all messages once you opt out.
privacy.howLongBody: We keep enquiry and booking details for 12 months after your last contact with us, then delete or anonymise them.
privacy.rightsBody: You can withdraw consent at any time. Use the opt-out page and we stop calls and messages to your number. You can also ask the showroom to see, correct or delete your data.
privacy.contactBody: For any privacy question, speak to the showroom manager at any Company A showroom.

optOut.title: Stop calls and messages
optOut.body: Enter your mobile number and we'll stop all calls, WhatsApp and SMS from Company A to that number.
optOut.successBody: We won't contact {phone} again. If you enquire again later, we'll ask for your consent afresh.
